description: Potraviny na pranýři, the food pillory, is the Czech public register of foods found by inspectors to breach food law, and of food establishments with serious findings. It is run by the Czech Agriculture and Food Inspection Authority (SZPI). Each food entry names the product, what was wrong with it (for example undeclared colourants, adulteration, contamination or spoilage), whether it was judged substandard, adulterated or unsafe, the food group, and the operator and country, with a photograph and date. Further sections list establishments with their address and findings, searchable on a map by town or postcode, websites selling risky products and the results of thematic inspection campaigns. Withdrawal from sale has already been ordered when an item is published. The site is free and available on the web with an RSS feed of new entries; no bulk download was found. Caveats: entries show inspection findings, not the full inspection programme, the RSS feed read carried only the latest 24 items, and quantities and distribution are not given. Simulation uses: building event series of food safety failures and fraud for food supply resilience studies, and mapping establishment closures in urban food systems. Related records: the Austrian AGES recall list (data-ages-product-warnings-recalls-austria) and the German food warnings portal (data-lebensmittelwarnung-food-warnings-germany) are neighbouring national sources.
